A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same R2E study and contain readable methods, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–W. Content can be reliably matched despite the changed title, formatting and numbering.

before.justification: v3 reports original gene-prediction evaluations, clinical-outcome prediction analyses, architecture ablations and evidence-auditing results in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical evaluations, including benchmark results, human/GPT-4 annotation comparisons and evidence-auditing outcomes.

M1.justification: The masked-entity corpus, MLM Retriever, convolutional/set-transformer Reasoner, training losses, Shapley explanations and frequency correction are unchanged. The new hyperparameter table summarizes the existing method.

E1.justification: Both versions use Held-out Biomedical Literature, Gene Description Facts, Clinical Trial Outcomes and their evidence-annotation datasets, with the same literature and genetics coverage. v4's dedicated held-out-literature subsection restates an existing evaluation.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain FREQ, MCS, MLM, the genetics baseline and GPT-4-FS-RAG-CoT. The Hadamard and PubMedBERT architecture comparisons in Appendix L are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Temporal splits, sample sizes, ranking/AUROC metrics, training budgets, retrieval counts and GPT-4 comparison procedures match. Table 3 in v4 restates settings already documented in v3 Appendix D; annotator qualifications are newly disclosed information.

E4.justification: The architecture ablations, non-stratified evaluation, disease-area analyses, genetics-combination comparisons, semantic-matching analysis and auditing/error examples are retained. Appendix U reorders existing analyses without adding evidence.

E5.justification: DeLong tests, Z-tests, Katz confidence intervals and Shapley Monte Carlo sampling remain unchanged. No new repeated-run, seed or uncertainty-reporting practice is introduced.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout. For example, Table 2 reports AUROC 0.633 for R2E-cor using both evidence sources and 0.638 for R2E-audit in both versions. Appendix results, case-study scores and all six figure images also match.

T1.justification: The Shapley algorithm and mathematical derivations in Appendices E–G, including the objective relationship and frequency correction, are retained. The gene–protein 1:1 assumption remains in Appendix C despite removal of its repetition from Section 3.1.

C1.justification: The central claims remain faithful evidence attribution, evidence updates without retraining, competitive drug-target prediction and release of three benchmarks. The revised title and application emphasis do not substantively change these contributions or performance claims.

C2.justification: v4 Section 6 explicitly discusses sensitivity to corpus completeness and the visibility of corpus biases through explanations. Section 4 additionally leaves detailed usability testing of Shapley explanations to future work. Existing result interpretations and other limitations remain.

D1.justification: Appendices N and R newly disclose expert annotators' qualifications, industry experience and consent. Appendix A additionally states supplementary-material availability while retaining the existing dataset repository and licences. Training and implementation details are otherwise unchanged.

R1.justification: v4 adds Wouters (2020) to support the introduction's discussion of drug-development costs. Relationships to retrieval models, explanation methods and hypothesis-generation research remain substantively unchanged; other reference edits primarily change bibliographic presentation.

P1.justification: v4 retitles the paper around explainable drug target identification and tightens main-text prose. It gives the existing held-out-literature summary its own subsection, moves Conclusions before Limitations, renames the Impact Statement and swaps two Appendix U subsections. Most paragraphs remain closely matched.

P2.justification: The document undergoes a comprehensive template change, altering page geometry, typography, margins, running headers and figure/table sizing and placement. v4 also adds hyperparameter Table 3 and expands Table 2's caption. Existing figure images and empirical table contents are retained.

improvement.justification: v4 modestly improves transparency through the corpus-completeness limitation, explicit deferral of usability testing and documented annotator expertise. Table 3 makes existing settings easier to consult. The scientific evidence remains unchanged, and duplicated dataset-access/licensing text in Appendix A adds redundancy, so the overall gain is limited.
